camera.convention: imu_link = base_link = egovehicle; both TF edges are egovehicle_SE3_sensor of calibration/; images treated as undistorted (av2-api PinholeCamera projects with K alone); source k1..k3 recorded only

lidar.points: ego-frame points of these lasers moved into the sensor frame with inverse(egovehicle_SE3_sensor); float16 in the source

motion.twist: finite differences between the poses nearest 0.05 s before and after, in the body frame

velodyne_time.model: a snapshot at the header; av2-api moves a sweep with one ego pose
